def make_article_info(self):
        """
        The Article Info contains the (self) Citation, Editors, Dates,
        Copyright, Funding Statement, Competing Interests Statement,
        Correspondence, and Footnotes. Maybe more...

        This content follows the Heading and precedes the Main segment in the
        output.

        This function accepts the receiving_node argument, which will receive
        all generated output as new childNodes.
        """
        # Create a new Div element
        article_info = self.xml_create_element('div')
        article_info.set('class', 'article-info')
        self.receiving_node.appendChild(article_info)

        self.receiving_node = article_info

        self.make_citation()
        self.make_editors()
        self.make_dates()
        self.make_copyright()
        self.make_funding_statement()
        self.make_competing_interests()
        self.make_correspondence()
        self.make_footnotes()

        self.receiving_node = self.receiving_node.parentNode
